subject: E-Commerce
title: The Buy Box Battle
description: A 60-second lesson on The Buy Box Battle.

hook.text: 82% of Amazon sales go through the Buy Box. Not winning it means your product is virtually invisible.

buildup.text: When multiple sellers offer the same product, Amazon's algorithm chooses one to display prominently—the Buy Box winner.

discovery.text: Price, fulfillment method, seller rating, and shipping speed all factor into Buy Box placement.

twist.text: Amazon's own products win the Buy Box at higher rates. The algorithm appears to favor its private label brands.

climax.text: The Buy Box concentrates power. One algorithm decides which seller gets 82% of the sales—total platform control.

punchline.text: 82% of sales from one button. The Buy Box is the most powerful spot online.

quiz.question: What is the Amazon Buy Box?
options: The algorithm that selects which seller is shown for the default purchase option
